title: solidago virgaurea subsp. litoralis
intro: Solidago virgaurea subsp. litoralis, commonly known as Littoral Goldenrod, is a subspecies of Solidago virgaurea, a perennial herbaceous plant native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Littoral Goldenrod are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The plant's bioactive constituents, particularly its flavonoids and terpenoids, may also contribute to its potential therapeutic uses, including its anti-cancer and anti-viral activities.
